summary: Phase 4 frontend-only testing completed. Global SRS aggregator (/study?srs=all) and Daily Notification settings both work end-to-end. All 7 acceptance criteria verified via Playwright. No backend regressions tested (no backend changes in this phase). 0 page errors during tests; only expected 401s from anonymous /api/me ping.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/lib/localStore.js localCapacity() assumes s.unlocks exists - if a malformed localStorage value lacks the key (rare in real flows but reproducible by external scripts), it throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading filter)'. Consider defensive default: (s.unlocks || []).filter(...). Caught during test setup with a partial seed payload but real users won't hit it because readStore() always returns the full default shape.
NotificationSettings sendTest only sets testing=true once and resets after 1500ms - if user double-clicks, second click is ignored (disabled). This is fine.
useDailyReminder polls every 5 min via setInterval - if user keeps tab open across day boundary while not studying, this works correctly because we recompute date each tick. Good.

Layout.jsx uses useDailyReminder() in every page that mounts Layout - this could fire duplicate intervals when navigating between pages. React StrictMode in dev would double-mount; in prod, navigation unmounts/remounts so cleanup runs. Acceptable.
test_credentials: Anonymous mode only; no auth credentials required.
seed_data_creation: Pre-seeded localStorage cnxue_local_v1 with 1 word slot (你好, 谢谢) + 1 sentence slot (我是学生。, 我爱你。) inside test scripts via page.evaluate. Cleared between tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 frontend-only acceptance verified. Notification.permission cannot be reliably set to 'granted' through page.context.grant_permissions alone in this Playwright build - use page.add_init_script to override window.Notification with a stub class that has permission='granted' BEFORE navigation. Example provided in this iteration's script. The denied/default UI paths are reachable via real browser permission. cnxue_srs_v1 keys are of form 'word::你好' / 'sentence::我是学生。' (kind-prefixed). Global SRS shows up to 30 candidate items as initial seed when no SRS state exists.
